I heard several arguments about "income inequality" (C_05). The first two proponents rated highly (98.5% and 99.3%) are emotionally charged but their persuasiveness score was low (45% and 35%). The third one (30% persuasiveness) was less convincing.

I currently oppose the $15 minimum wage partly because of C_06 ("small-business survival"). While C_05 ("income inequality") is a real issue, I need to consider how it interacts with my existing views.

Since I already strongly oppose the policy, and the new arguments are mixed in terms of persuasiveness and direction:
1.  The high persuasiveness of the proponents of C_05 was not strong enough to shift my strong opposition to the minimum wage.
2.  The third, weaker proponent of C_05 (30% persuasiveness) was not compelling enough to warrant an addition.

I will not make any changes to my existing weights. The new information did not change my conviction.
